name: project-clone-self-heal
description: Scheduler self-heal for ephemeral volumes (warren-1ec7): registered-project host clones can vanish (fresh PVC after redeploy). src/triggers/project-heal.ts re-clones on demand (createProjectCloneHealer injected as TickDeps.ensureProjectClone), pinning stored defaultBranch and forwarding GITHUB_TOKEN per warren-57ad auth; failed re-clones back off 5m→1h; per-project error notices (project_failed, sd_list_failed) gate to once/hour via ProjectHealTracker instead of flooding every tick.
